authorization: User requested merge to main and production deployment of the current profile and timezone changes.
scope: Create private user profiles and deploy the Next profile route, authenticated save action, preferences provider and timezone-aware displays. Include the prior removal of assessment IDs from catalog cards.
release_blockers: Source hashes match the passing local validation record; current unit checks, lint and normal build pass.
Verify AWS account and actual Supabase project identity before production mutation. Reject an unexpected existing profile table/function.
Apply only the versioned profiles migration, then verify exact columns, RLS, owner policies, grants, constraints and timezone validation; anonymous profile SQL access remains denied.
Retain active prompt settings; do not deploy research worker, host or infrastructure runtime changes.
Release the exact committed frontend revision only after database verification succeeds; require Amplify build/deploy/verify success.
Production anonymous profile API is 401, /profile sign-in return is preserved, and public timestamps use the browser timezone.

When a legitimate Google session is available, exercise the actual profile save action behind CloudFront, reload persisted values, check preference-based assessment timestamps and restore the original preferences.

authenticated_check_bounds.names: Do not change the displayed name inputs.
authenticated_check_bounds.timezone: Save the current browser default if this is the first profile; temporarily compare another supported zone and restore the baseline timezone.
authenticated_check_bounds.other_users: Do not modify other users or manufacture production accounts.

conditional_checks: If a legitimate Google session is unavailable, record that gap explicitly; synthetic local transport is not production authentication.
A second legitimate user session is not required; production catalog/policy inspection plus the local cross-owner SQL regressions provide bounded ownership evidence.

checks.invalid_and_missing: Invalid timezone, missing profile/browser fallback and storage failure covered locally; production invalid timezone action must preserve saved values.

rollback: If necessary redeploy the prior frontend commit. Retain the additive private profiles table and user preferences; do not drop personal data as an automatic rollback.
